candidates.taxon: King boletes in the Northern Rockies (Boletus edulis sensu lato; not B. rubriceps)
candidates.why: Arora & Frank 2014 describe B. rubriceps as abundant in the southern Rocky Mountains/Southwest and state that its exact northern range limit was unresolved, so transferring it north is not defensible. Interior king boletes exist as an edulis-sensu-lato complex whose species concepts and host attributions remain unresolved in the reviewed sources.

Implemented with its own progression calendar and elevation proxy; no Colorado/interior/PNW coefficients transferred.
